positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: In the SF League of Pissed Off Voters questionnaire she said she supports building substantially more housing and spreading it more equitably across the city, and supports the central goal of the Family Zoning Plan, alongside affordability and anti-displacement measures.

citations.quote:
I support building substantially more housing in San Francisco and distributing that responsibility more equitably across the city rather than continuing to concentrate growth in neighborhoods like District 10. I
therefore support the central goal of the Family Zoning Plan.
citations.locator: p. 8, answer to "How did you vote or would you have voted on Mayor Lurie’s Family Zoning Plan?"
